notes: The booklet image is low-resolution and has no inventory page; several piece identities (yellow cab piece, grey clip plates, boom pieces, drill pieces) are best-guess matches to catalogue types.
The translucent red plate in step 5 is modelled as lego-302421 (red plate 1x1) since no translucent red square plate exists in the catalogue.

Boom hinge chain (steps 9-10), the drill (step 11) and its attachment to the boom end are approximated; the drill bit is clipped into a grey clip plate (b20), which sits on the black plate b17, and b17 is placed on the 2-finger hinge plate b16 (stud.1.1).

Several parts connect to the same stud-bearing piece (e.g. b1 top, b4 top). The catalogue only lists one stud port for these, so extra joins leave that port null; they do not use the same physical stud.

Minifig legs rest on the cab (contact edge, no ports) because the legs' only catalogue port is the hip, which joins the torso. Head-to-torso uses null ports because the catalogue's neck ports are socket-kind and stud-kind and the checker does not accept that pair.

Wheels (step 12, 4x): each yellow rim (lego-4170457, pin-hole type) is pressed into a black tyre (ports left null because the catalogue's rim/tire ports are both ball-kind) and then onto a wheel-holder pin; attach overrides map the four pins.
